notes: Original poster explicitly says they disenchanted this one item on May 15, 2026; its individual item-restoration listing requires 1 Dawn Crystal and 1 Swirling Arcane Essence (plus a weekly Enchanting knowledge tracking item). Item Restoration reclaims materials generated by disenchanting, corroborated at https://www.wowhead.com/forums/topic/item-retrieval-258608 . This is ONE indirect source-backed completed operation with one Dawn Crystal, NOT an event-stream export, rate estimate, verified full material set, or evidence of any broader output distribution. Mantle of Dark Devotion maps to item 251085 by https://www.wowhead.com/item=251085/mantle-of-dark-devotion . Game itemLink/bonus IDs, actual item level, true rarity/upgrade track, character Enchanting skill/specialization, crystal quality rank/item ID, exact hotfix build and any other outputs remain unknown. Restoration displayed no rank, so both outputItemID and outputRank are null. Never pool it with unrelated Wowhead Looter submissions without source-level deduplication.
